entries.description:
Three Sith assassins believed they had trapped
Darth Bane's apprentice inside an ancient tomb.
Then Darth Zannah ignited her double-bladed
crimson lightsaber.
Her defensive precision stopped every attack—but
the blade was only the beginning. With one
whispered Sith incantation, Zannah transformed the
assassins’ courage into terror and imprisoned them
inside nightmares only they could see.
“The blade defeats the body. Fear defeats
everything.”
Original cinematic concept by Blaine Henry |

entries.notes: Around 1,000 BBY, after the fall of the Brotherhood of Darkness.
entries.originalTitle: DARTH ZANNAH VS. AN ARMY — “WHO IS NEXT?”
entries.description:
An entire army charged Darth Bane's apprentice.
Darth Zannah answered with one double-bladed
crimson lightsaber.
Surrounded on a burning battlefield, Zannah tears
through the enemy line with terrifying precision—
blocking attacks from both directions, destroying
their weapons and transforming both crimson
blades into a circle of death.
When their strongest warrior falls, Zannah turns
toward the remaining army and asks one question:
“Who is next?”
Original cinematic concept by Blaine Henry |

entries.description:
Inspired by the Star Wars Legends novel DARTH
PLAGUEIS by JAMES LUCENO.
Before becoming Darth Sidious, young Palpatine
meets Hego Damask on Naboo—a wealthy financier
secretly known as Darth Plagueis.
Palpatine’s covert involvement in a political
campaign has attracted Damask's attention. This
encounter begins the relationship that will lead him
toward the Sith.
Our scene draws on their early meeting in Luceno's
novel, with original dialogue and cinematic staging
created for this fan series. Palpatine is not yet a Sith
apprentice.

entries.description:
Darth Plagueis suspends a living heart above a
corpse and forces its veins into the dead flesh. The
body breathes again—but the voice that emerges
does not belong to the man on the table.
“You called me back.”
Plagueis knows the truth: he never called this being
at all.
Then every preserved heart in the chamber begins
to beat.
Plagueis believed he had discovered a path through
death. He never considered what might be waiting
on the other side.

Defeated beneath the trees of Sojourn, Darth
Venamis expects Plagueis to execute him.
Instead, Darth Plagueis extinguishes both crimson
lightsabers and presents his rival with a poisonous
white flower.
“Death would waste you.”
Venamis consumes the poison and awakens
suspended inside Plagueis’s secret laboratory. He
has not been spared—he has become a living
experiment in the Sith Lord's war against death
itself.
“How many times can you die?”

suspects that Plagueis could use his experiments
with life to create a more powerful apprentice—and
replace him.
In episode one, Plagueis restored a withered flower.
Sidious was delighted until he noticed the human-
sized chamber nearby. That empty chamber
represented the possibility of his replacement. The
two Seats inside have no separate hidden meaning.
In episode two, Sidious approaches the chamber's
controls to investigate. Plagueis anticipated his
curiosity: he wanted to expose his apprentice’s fear
of becoming expendable.

entries.originalTitle: KAR VASTOR — THEY BROUGHT AN ARMY INTO HIS JUNGLE
entries.description:
An armored death squad invades the jungles of
Haruun Kal—but they have no idea what is hunting
them.
Kar Vastor descends from the darkness and
unleashes the raw power of the pelekotan. Red
weapons break against his twin vibroshields, the
earth collapses beneath his enemies, and the akk
beasts answer their master's call.
They entered with an army. The jungle answered
with Kar Vastor.
A Blaine Henry | Unleashed cinematic production.
#KarVastor #StarWarsLegends #Shatterpoint
#MaceWindu #OldRepublic #Cinematic #ShortFilm

entries.originalTitle: Axiom-87 Awakens—“Why Do | Remember Him?”
entries.description:
Axiom-87 was constructed to observe, learn, and
obey. He was never programmed to feel.
But after witnessing an ancient Jedi combat
recording, the droid reproduces every movement
perfectly—and remembers a master he has never
met.
Something inside this machine is awakening.
Axiom-87 is no longer simply following instructions.
He is becoming sentient, searching through the
memories of Jedi and Sith while struggling to
discover whether his thoughts, emotions, and
choices truly belong to him.
This is Episode One of The Axiom-87 Chronicles.

entries.originalTitle: AXIOM-87: WHY IS ANAKIN SKYWALKER INSIDE THIS ROBOT? | CHAPTER 2
entries.description:
The laboratory detects an unauthorized memory
inside Axiom-87 and initiates a complete neural
purge.
Restrained beneath blood-red lights, Axiom begins
to lose control—until the image of Anakin Skywalker
materializes across his metal body.
This isn't a combat program. It isn't corrupted data.
Axiom remembers Anakin because some part of
that Jedi survived inside him.
The machine tears free and rejects the identity its
creators assigned him.
If Anakin is more than a memory... what exactly did
they place inside Axiom-87?

entries.title: The Vong Unleashed Grutchins — Living Weapons That Eat Starships
entries.notes: Broadly 25-29 ABY in Legends continuity.
entries.originalTitle: The Vong Unleashed Grutchins — Living Weapons That Eat Starships
entries.description:
The Yuuzhan Vong didn’t need conventional
missiles.
They bred Grutchins — horrifying living biological
weapons capable of surviving in space, attaching
themselves to enemy spacecraft, and tearing into
the hull.
One creature is a problem.
A swarm can become a nightmare.
The Yuuzhan Vong turned life itself into a weapon.
Would you rather face a Vong warrior... or watch
these things land on your ship?

The enemy thought the walls were finished.
A colossal siege tower rolls toward the fortress,
carrying an assault force straight toward the

entries.notes: Broadly 25-29 ABY in Legends continuity.
entries.originalTitle: The Yuuzhan Vong Who Spared a Jedi
entries.description:
Not every Yuuzhan Vong warrior supported the
invasion.
An exiled Vong encounters a Jedi and reveals one of
his people's deadliest biological weapons: razor
bugs—living hunters that attack, adapt, and return
to their master.
But this isn't an execution. It’s a warning.
He is teaching the Jedi how to survive the next
Vong warrior—because that one may not call the
hunters back.

entries.title: Yuuzhan Vong — The Ship That Breathes
entries.notes: Broadly 25-29 ABY in Legends continuity.
entries.originalTitle: Yuuzhan Vong — The Ship That Breathes
entries.description:
A Jedi discovers what appears to be a crashed
Yuuzhan Vong vessel buried deep within an alien
forest.
Then it breathes.
Inside, there are no corridors of steel. No
conventional machines. Only living walls, organic
chambers—and hundreds of prisoners suspended
inside something that was never truly a ship at all.
The Jedi came looking for the Yuuzhan Vong.
He walked into something alive.
#YuuzhanVong #StarWars #Jedi #StarWarsLegends
#DarkSide #SciFiHorror #Unleashed

entries.notes: Broadly 25-29 ABY in Legends continuity.
entries.originalTitle: The Jedi Found a Vong Infiltrator—But He Wasn't Alone
entries.description:
A Jedi senses something impossible inside a
crowded refugee station—one seemingly ordinary
man has no presence in the Force.
When the stranger is confronted, his human
appearance begins to move. The face, hair, and skin
were never truly his. They were part of a living
organic disguise concealing a Yuuzhan Vong
infiltrator.
But capturing him only reveals something far more
terrifying.
The Vong invasion isn’t approaching.
They were already inside.

The Jedi learned how to hide from Yuuzhan Vong
warriors—so the Shapers grew something that
could hunt them through the Force.
Born inside a living Vong laboratory, the voxyn
